## Patterns

| Keyword | Description | Example |
|---------|-------------|---------|
| `SDK Init (Trusted)` | Create SDK with trusted mode for proof verification | `const sdk = EvoSDK.testnetTrusted(); await sdk.connect();` |
| `SDK Init (Custom Addresses)` | Connect to specific masternodes | `const sdk = EvoSDK.withAddresses(['https://52.12.176.90:1443'], 'testnet'); await sdk.connect();` |
| `SDK Init (With Settings)` | Configure timeouts and retries | `const sdk = EvoSDK.testnetTrusted({ settings: { timeoutMs: 8000 } }); await sdk.connect();` |
| `SDK Init (With Logs)` | Enable WASM debug logging | `const sdk = new EvoSDK({ network: 'testnet', logs: 'wasm_sdk=debug,rs_dapi_client=warn' }); await sdk.connect();` |
| `WASM Init Guard` | Ensure WASM is initialized before creating objects | `await ensureInitialized(); // or await getEvoSdk();` |
| `Identity Fetch` | Fetch and inspect identity | `const identity = await sdk.identities.fetch(identityId); const json = identity.toJSON();` |
| `Identity Balance` | Get balance as bigint, convert to number | `const balance = await sdk.identities.balance(id); const credits = Number(balance ?? 0n);` |
| `Identity Create` | Create identity from asset lock | `const proof = AssetLockProof.createInstantAssetLockProof(islockBytes, txBytes, outputIndex); const identity = new Identity(proof.createIdentityId().toString()); identity.addPublicKey(new IdentityPublicKey({keyId, purpose, securityLevel, keyType, isReadOnly: false, data})); const signer = new IdentitySigner(); signer.addKeyFromWif(wif); await sdk.identities.create({identity, assetLockProof: proof, assetLockPrivateKey: PrivateKey.fromWIF(wif), signer});` |
| `Identity Top-Up` | Top up identity from asset lock proof | `const proof = AssetLockProof.createInstantAssetLockProof(islockBytes, txBytes, outputIndex); await sdk.identities.topUp({identity, assetLockProof: proof, assetLockPrivateKey: PrivateKey.fromWIF(wif)});` |
| `Identity Update (Add Key)` | Add encryption key to identity | `const newKey = new IdentityPublicKeyInCreation({keyId, purpose: 'ENCRYPTION', securityLevel: 'MEDIUM', keyType: 'ECDSA_SECP256K1', isReadOnly: false, data: publicKeyBytes}); const signer = new IdentitySigner(); signer.addKeyFromWif(masterKeyWif); signer.addKey(PrivateKey.fromHex(newKeyHex, network)); await sdk.identities.update({identity, addPublicKeys: [newKey], signer});` |
| `Identity Update (Disable Key)` | Disable public keys on identity | `await sdk.identities.update({identity, signer, disablePublicKeys: [keyId1, keyId2]});` |
| `Document Query` | Query documents with where/orderBy | `const docs = await sdk.documents.query({dataContractId, documentTypeName: 'post', where: [['$ownerId', '==', id], ['$createdAt', '>', 0]], orderBy: [['$ownerId', 'asc'], ['$createdAt', 'desc']], limit: 20});` |
| `Document Query (In Clause)` | Query with `in` operator for multiple values | `await sdk.documents.query({dataContractId, documentTypeName, where: [['records.identity', 'in', ownerIds]], orderBy: [['records.identity', 'asc']], limit: 100});` |
| `Document Query (startsWith)` | Prefix search with startsWith | `await sdk.documents.query({dataContractId, documentTypeName, where: [['normalizedLabel', 'startsWith', prefix], ['normalizedParentDomainName', '==', 'dash']], orderBy: [['normalizedLabel', 'asc']], limit: 10});` |
| `Map Response` | Convert SDK Map response to array | `const docs = Array.from(response.values()).filter(Boolean).map(d => d.toJSON());` |
| `Document Get` | Get single document by ID | `const doc = await sdk.documents.get(contractId, 'post', documentId); if (doc) { const data = doc.toJSON(); }` |
| `Document Create (Manual ST)` | Build ST manually for idempotent retry | `const doc = new Document({properties: data, documentTypeName, dataContractId, ownerId, revision: 1n}); const createTx = new DocumentCreateTransition({document: doc, identityContractNonce: nonce}); const batched = new BatchedTransition(createTx.toDocumentTransition()); const batch = BatchTransition.fromBatchedTransitions([batched], ownerId, 0); const st = batch.toStateTransition(); st.sign(PrivateKey.fromWIF(wif), identityKey); await sdk.stateTransitions.broadcastStateTransition(st); await sdk.stateTransitions.waitForResponse(st);` |
| `Document Replace` | Update document with typed API | `const doc = new Document({properties: data, documentTypeName, dataContractId, ownerId, revision: BigInt(newRevision), id: documentId}); const {signer, identityKey} = await signerService.createSignerFromWasmKey(wif, wasmKey); await sdk.documents.replace({document: doc, identityKey, signer});` |
| `Document Delete` | Delete document with typed API | `await sdk.documents.delete({document: {id, ownerId, dataContractId, documentTypeName}, identityKey, signer});` |
| `Contract Fetch` | Fetch and cache data contract | `const contract = await sdk.contracts.fetch(contractId); if (!contract) throw new Error('Not found');` |
| `Contract Preload` | Preload multiple contracts in parallel | `await Promise.allSettled(contractIds.map(id => sdk.contracts.fetch(id)));` |
| `DPNS Resolve` | Resolve username to identity ID | `const identityId = await sdk.dpns.resolveName('alice'); // returns string or undefined` |
| `DPNS Register` | Register DPNS name with preorder callback | `const signer = new IdentitySigner(); signer.addKeyFromWif(wif); await sdk.dpns.registerName({label: 'alice', identity, identityKey: identity.getPublicKeyById(keyId), signer, preorderCallback: () => console.log('preorder done')});` |
| `DPNS Validate` | Validate + check availability | `const isValid = await sdk.dpns.isValidUsername(label); const isContested = await sdk.dpns.isContestedUsername(label); const available = await sdk.dpns.isNameAvailable(label);` |
| `DPNS Usernames` | Get all usernames for identity | `const names = await sdk.dpns.usernames({identityId, limit: 20});` |
| `Signer Creation` | Create IdentitySigner from WIF | `const signer = new IdentitySigner(); signer.addKeyFromWif(privateKeyWif);` |
| `Signer With Multiple Keys` | Signer for update (master + new key proof) | `const signer = new IdentitySigner(); signer.addKeyFromWif(masterWif); signer.addKey(PrivateKey.fromHex(newKeyHex, network));` |
| `PrivateKey From WIF` | Create PrivateKey from WIF string | `const pk = PrivateKey.fromWIF('cVExample...');` |
| `PrivateKey From Hex` | Create PrivateKey from hex + network | `const pk = PrivateKey.fromHex(hexString, 'testnet');` |
| `Address Transfer` | Transfer credits between platform addresses | `const signer = new PlatformAddressSigner(); const addr = signer.addKey(privateKey); const input = new PlatformAddressInput(addr, 0n, 100000n); const output = new PlatformAddressOutput(recipientAddr, 90000n); await sdk.addresses.transfer({inputs: [input], outputs: [output], signer});` |
| `Fund From Asset Lock` | Fund platform address from asset lock | `const proof = AssetLockProof.createInstantAssetLockProof(islockBytes, txBytes, outputIndex); const signer = new PlatformAddressSigner(); const addr = signer.addKey(addrKey); await sdk.addresses.fundFromAssetLock({assetLockProof: proof, assetLockPrivateKey: PrivateKey.fromWIF(wif), outputs: [{address: recipientAddress}], signer});` |
| `WithProof Variant` | Every query has a `*WithProof` variant returning proof metadata | `const result = await sdk.identities.fetchWithProof(id); // ProofMetadataResponseTyped<Identity>` |
| `Error Handling (WasmSdkError)` | WasmSdkError has getters: `message`, `code`, `kind`, `retriable`, `name` | `try { ... } catch (e) { const msg = e?.message; const kind = e?.kind; const retriable = e?.retriable; }` |
| `Connection Recovery` | Re-initialize on "no available addresses" error | `if (msg.includes('no available addresses')) { await cleanup(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2000)); await initialize(config); }` |
| `Nonce Management` | Manual nonce for idempotent document creation | `const nonce = await sdk.wasm.getIdentityContractNonce(ownerId, contractId); const MASK = (1n << 40n) - 1n; const newNonce = (nonce ?? 0n & MASK) + 1n;` |
| `ST Bytes Cache` | Cache signed ST bytes for timeout retry | `const bytes = st.toBytes(); savePendingSTBytes(docId, bytes); /* on retry: */ const cached = loadPendingSTBytes(docId); const st = StateTransition.fromBytes(cached); await sdk.stateTransitions.broadcastStateTransition(st);` |
| `Refresh Nonce Cache` | Refresh SDK internal nonce after manual ST | `await sdk.wasm.refreshIdentityNonce(new Identifier(ownerId));` |
| `Singleton Service` | Service singleton pattern used in yappr | `class MyService { ... } export const myService = new MyService();` |
| `Base Document Service` | Abstract base for typed document CRUD | `class PostService extends BaseDocumentService<Post> { protected transformDocument(doc) { ... } }` |
| `Default Identity Keys (HD)` | Standard 5-key identity setup from mnemonic | `generateDefaultIdentityKeysHD(network, mnemonic) // [Master, High Auth, Critical Auth, Transfer, Encryption]` |
| `Key Matching` | Find which identity key matches a WIF private key | `const match = findMatchingKeyIndex(wif, identity.publicKeys, network); // {keyId, securityLevel, purpose}` |
| `Asset Lock Transaction` | Build Type 8 asset lock from UTXO | `const tx = createAssetLockTransaction(utxo, assetLockPubKey, 1000n); const signed = signTransaction(tx, ...); const txid = calculateTxId(signed);` |
| `InstantSend Lock Wait` | Poll for IS lock then build proof | `const islock = await dapiClient.waitForInstantSendLock(txid, 60000); const proof = buildInstantAssetLockProof(islock, txBytes, outputIndex);` |
| `Token ID Calculation` | Calculate token ID offline | `const tokenId = await sdk.tokens.calculateId(contractId, 0);` |
